jointContract: Two fixed-size watchdog controllers are previewed; actual state commits only through the earliest nominal reset time. Per-stage catch-up is not used.
At equal times TRM1.1 Table9.1-1 orders SWD12/RWDTSystem10/RWDTCore09 before MWDT0Core07 before RWDTCPU0d.
LP/TIMG reset domains apply at watchdog_reset_at; CPU/Core retention clears dispatched/coincident requests while retaining LP count and phase.

A late service may expose a later independent event after the earlier reset is applied; each service/reboot handles one bounded boundary. The returned cause remains the captured cause of that applied reset.
Pending global reset forbids advancing TIMG MMIO or writing watchdog state; pure LP readback remains available.
Cold selection validates LP and TIMG candidates before assigning either. Core/System do not replay the boot latch. Chip reset permits a fresh checked epoch. Raw/SRAM deselection cannot rearm it.
The diagnostic Bringup stops before another retirement after a reset request; common Machine remains the product scheduler.
